FN-9YSEPPP-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 22
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Sponsor: Senator Merika Coleman
Development
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 02/12/2025
Senate Bill 22 as introduced could increase receipts to the Education Trust Fund and the State
General Fund by undetermined amounts dependent on the amount of Alabama Jobs Act
incentives recaptured from incentivized companies found to have violated the provisions of this
bill.
Page 1
